fusions.name: Close Reading
fusions.desc: A glance that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its maximum range of 8 tiles. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Censor's Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a censor's gaze across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 28 damage to every enemy in it. Every hit is a critical hit, and each enemy hit is [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Between the Lines
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Double-Take
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
